extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Paint tools — pencil (thin lines), brush (thick strokes), eraser (remove drawing), fill bucket (fill colour in closed shape), shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle), text (write words on drawing). (2) File management — file (stores work like a drawing or document), folder (stores many files together like a box), desktop (main screen with icons), icons (small pictures that represent files and programs). (3) Creating and naming files — open a program, click File > New, draw your work, click File > Save, give the file a name you can remember, click Save. (4) Opening and closing files — double click a file to open it, click the X at the top to close it, always save before closing. (5) Computer etiquette — sit straight with back supported, eyes level with the top of the screen, wrists straight while typing, take a break every 20-30 minutes, wash hands before using the computer, do not eat or drink near the computer, do not bang the keys, be gentle with mouse and keyboard. Misconceptions: 'folder and file are the same' (folder holds many files, a file is one piece of work), 'eraser deletes the whole file' (eraser only removes part of the drawing, not the whole file), 'you should sit any way that feels comfortable' (correct posture prevents back and eye problems), 'you can eat while using the computer' (food and water can damage the keyboard and computer). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ComputerFilesGame), NOT export default. Export interface ComputerFilesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
